subject: Aboard the colony ship ariadne, in the bay where the work is being done. Things are walking out of the stores Samuel keeps: a sack of seed, then a coil of cable, then another sack. Samuel has started sleeping in there, which isn't helping anything. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.

notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads.
